# The physics model dialog (menu 262) edited through its edit boxes (typed
# and committed with Enter, PhysicsEditSubclassProc) and by dragging the
# selected body on the viewport tool (EditModeRecord): body 0 moved, sized
# (shift), and rotated, body 3 renamed and moved; the joint page (801) and
# a joint edit. Cancel drops the drag before it. Joint drags: README.md.
load model .\lips.pmd
save pmd before.pmd
physics model open
dialog edit 718 2.5
dialog edit 720 0.75
physics drag move y none 10
physics drag move x shift -4
physics drag rotate z none 25
dialog select 704 3
dialog edit 705 body3
physics drag move z none 3
dialog click 801
dialog edit 744 0.5
dialog ok
save pmd dragged.pmd
save pmm dragged.pmm

physics model open
physics drag move y none 20
dialog cancel
save pmd cancelled.pmd
